judgments.note: Staging a smart turnaround and participating in industry growth opportunities is strategic language without a measurable target or horizon.
The GF3 facility is said to be coming into commission and its physical scale is described, but no commissioning deadline or bounded horizon is stated.

normalized_claim.normalized_claim: Generate approximately INR1,200 crore to INR1,300 crore of revenue in the referenced business this year.
Fully utilize the Sitapur capacity for the company's own branded business within three to four years.

judgments.note: Continuing to deleverage while investing in growth projects states a direction, but no leverage target or deadline is provided; the debt figures are historical/current context.
The immediately preceding analyst question explicitly frames the comparison for H2, and management commits to outperforming industry growth in that period.

normalized_claim.normalized_claim: Deliver higher growth than the industry during H2.

judgments.note: Initiating renewal of mining approvals is a procedural/regulatory action, and the candidate gives no explicit initiation deadline separate from the current 2029/2031 validity dates.
Growth above 15% is numerical, but 'in years to come' is not a bounded resolution horizon under frozen V001.
Submitting or going for CC by the end of next week is a procedural approval/certification filing step rather than an operating or financial performance commitment used by H003.

The Netherlands savings ambition of around GBP500 million has no review-visible completion horizon. The preceding GBP540 million fixed-cost target is a separate statement and is not substituted for this candidate.
This restates the same 18,000-20,000 MVA transformation-capacity addition within two months already captured by the earlier accepted candidate.
Management expects external gas prices to be somewhat better and says it is making efforts to augment production, but states neither a production target nor a bounded delivery horizon.
Management expects to finalize an order next year and is working on several more orders, but the order quantity/value is garbled and award/finalization is not a company-controlled delivery outcome.
Margins are expected to stabilize, but management explicitly expresses uncertainty about reaching historical EBIT-margin highs and gives no objective stabilization level or deadline.

International-patient revenue is currently about 8% and management expects it to remain stable, but V001 has no numerical tolerance for 'stable' and the current-year phrase applies to the preceding growth discussion rather than a clean revenue-mix horizon.
Not adding new product categories in the 'near future' is a negative strategic intention with no bounded resolution horizon; the capex mention is non-quantified in this candidate.
The BharatNet EBITDA-margin range of 12%-14% is numerical, but no fiscal/calendar or other bounded measurement horizon is stated for when the margin is to be achieved.
Looking at further actions to stimulate growth in the first half of next year is a contingent management action plan without a measurable growth target.

judgments.note: The 4 GW/7 GW figures are expectations for evacuation capacity becoming available under an externally monitored grid plan, not a company-controlled operating-delivery commitment.
